memory.content: Never pay to be listed in directories. Skip checkout, paid queues, featured/badge fees, and paid expedites. Free listings only. If a form ends on payment, stop, log as paid-only, and do not ask the user to pay.

Prefer forms over outbound listing emails. Ask the user before any listing email. Never send listing emails from Gmail (it re-wraps links as google.com/url). If approved, send from a company mailbox with clean official URLs only.
Work style: submit listings autonomously; only ping the user for login, 2FA, or captcha (never for payment); keep them posted on every new submission.
Before every directory submission, search that directory for an existing listing for the product; if found, log as already listed and do not re-submit.
Never paste raw docs/GitBook markdown into directory listings (no raw .md URLs, callouts, or heading dumps). Write short plain-prose copy from the product brief.
In all directory listings and emails, only use official product URLs. Never google.com/url or other redirect/tracking wrappers.

Before submitting to any directory, also probe common listing slugs for the product (kebab and concatenated forms) on paths like /products/, /product/, /tools/, /tool/, /ai-tools/, /ai-tool/, /directory/, /p/, and /{slug}, plus site search. If a real listing page exists, log as already listed and skip. Do not trust a 404 on only one path.

Prefer highly targeted niche industry software directories (tools for a specific trade or vertical such as HVAC, plumbing, roofing, electrical, construction, field service, home services, agencies, franchise, white-label) over generic AI/SaaS dump lists. Skip contractor business listings (find-a-plumber style), spam, and link farms.
For directory listing uploads, prefer opaque logos with solid backgrounds. Do not upload transparent logos unless the form specifically asks for transparency.
Directory submission loop runs every day at 9am local time, including weekends.
Do not invent a phone number for directory forms. If a form requires a phone and none is on file, skip and log needs-phone.
Do not use a personal name as the public byline/author on directory listings; use the company or product name.
Out of scope for this workflow unless the user says otherwise: G2, Capterra, Product Hunt, AppSumo, Indie Hackers, GetApp, and Software Advice.

Track every attempt in a local submissions log (status, listing URL, notes). Prefer niche reputation / local-service / agency directories first; deprioritize broad SaaS/startup dump lists unless they still reach that audience.

This workflow uses Gmail for directory account signup verification: complete the verify link, then trash that verification email only. Company/work email is used when a listing should show a company address or when sending approved listing emails.
